api_cases.answer:
纵向裂缝：优先级为 P3，预计维修时间为 60 分钟，严重度为低（low）。

宽纵向裂缝：优先级为 P2，预计维修时间为 120 分钟，严重度为中等（medium）。

以上依据项目当前维修规则；工时是项目设定的预计值。

On 2026-10-14, course-simulation demo-rules-v2 durations were finalized: eight severity/priority mappings remain unchanged, with P3/P2/P1 expected service times 60/120/240 minutes. One primary box >= 0.60 automatically creates one task; lower confidence requires review. These durations are neither deadlines nor measured values. Formal engineering rules and real-scenario calibration still lack evidence. The executable routing demo already specifies a 480-minute shift, return to depot and b-objective-v1 weights. Formal operational approval/calibration of these values, crew capability assumptions and task deadlines remain pending. Vehicle access at the NUS-ISS reference point and task-road eligibility remain unverified. Optional Google matrices and saved Google experiments exist; they do not establish road-work permission or current traffic.

## Canonical label dictionary



The sole label dictionary is `rdd2022es-v1-labels-1`, from version 1 of Juuso's `juusos/rdd2022es`, member `combined_annotatedv2/classes.txt`. This package rechecks IDs and names already verified in the repository; it neither redownloads data nor claims full training-data quality acceptance. IDs are 0-7. Base RDD2022 D00/D10/D20/D40 are damage-family codes, not substitutes for these eight class IDs.

| class_id | source_name | label_key | English display | Base family code | Visual qualifier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 7 | pothole deep | pothole_deep | Deep pothole | D40 | deep |

`wide`, `sunken` and `deep` are visual categories in the source dataset, not measured crack widths, subsidence/pothole depths or structural diagnoses. An unqualified category does not prove minor damage either. The label dictionary does not directly provide severity, priority, service_minutes or due_at. Current mappings are defined only by demo rules, not the dataset or formal engineering standards. Cite actual delivery evidence for the relevant model version when discussing training splits, real inference or per-class metrics; these cannot be inferred from the label dictionary.

api_cases.question: 项目的起始调度点在哪里？有多少支工程队？
api_cases.answer: 该项目的起始调度点为共享的起点，地址是新加坡国立大学信息系统学院（NUS-ISS），具体位置为25 Heng Mui Keng Terrace，纬度1.292149，经度103.776551，该地点作为虚拟起点，并非真正的维修作业地址。项目中共有4支工程队，编号为crew-01至crew-04。这些工程队均从该共同起点出发开展任务。

selections.quote: One fictional repair department uses four simulated crews: `crew-01`, `crew-02`, `crew-03`, `crew-04`. Their shared origin is NUS-ISS, 25 Heng Mui Keng Terrace, latitude `1.292149`, longitude `103.776551`, depot version `nus-iss-v1`. This is a simulated origin at a real address, not actual NUS-ISS repair operations.

Each input task must appear exactly once, either in a crew's ordered stops or in unassigned_tasks. Unknown service duration, inaccessible travel and shift limits are constraints, not permission to drop tasks silently. All available crews begin at the same depot at planning_start_at. This is static replanning from a common start; there is no live vehicle tracking, in-transit dispatch or task time-window model.

The b-routing-demo-v1 configuration uses four crews, the shared NUS-ISS depot, return_to_depot=true, a 480-minute shift and a simulated matrix by default. These demonstration assumptions do not resolve the shared operational policy's null values.
